To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the past and the future are not only linked by a common present, but that they also inform each other in ways which are often overlooked in conventional historical accounts of urban parks.
urban parks are a key site for the creation of order in the modern city, but that this order is fragile, and subject to change over time.

(i) the historical and contemporary significance of public parks is rooted in the ways they are imagined and experienced; (ii) the historical and present day significance of parks is rooted in their role in shaping and reflecting urban order and disorder; (iii) the historical and future significance of public parks can be explored through a conceptual frame of'spaces of past experience' and'spaces of future expectation'.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the ways in which the past is used to shape urban futures and the ways in which urban futures are used to shape the past.
the ways in which past, present and futures interact to produce the urban landscape and the social relations that constitute urban life.
the role of parks in shaping the future, as well as the role of parks as a site of future shaping.
